title: Binyamin Ganzakhya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:6 relates that he went out and reported in Rav’s name that first intercourse with a virgin on Shabbat is permitted. Shmuel heard and became angry with him; Binyamin died, and Shmuel said of him, “Blessed is the Omnipresent who struck him.” Niddah 65a relates the incident with the name Minyamin Saksanaa; Yuchasin reads Binyamin Ganuvya.

notes.text: The Jerusalem Talmud’s terse pronouns are clarified by Niddah 65a: Minyamin dies on the road, and Shmuel speaks about the event. The notice has Binyamin Ganzakhya, the Bavli Minyamin Saksanaa, and the cited Yuchasin Binyamin Ganuvya.
